hero.tagline: Agility, product mindset, sport & performance — the thread that guides my work.

stripe.title: From field to backlog
stripe.text: The same standards as in a WOD or sprint review: measurable progress, consistency, and clear communication. I like everyone to know where we are going — and why.

bio.title: My introduction
bio.lede: Developer focused on impact and collaboration — from user need to deployment.
bio.text: Software development engineer passionate about sport and performance. As a full stack developer (Python, PHP, React), I grew in agile practices at Elonet: rigor, autonomy, and team spirit. I enjoy building useful tools from discovery to deployment, and helping make sport accessible to everyone when context allows.

method.title: How I work
method.lede: Transparency, proactivity, feedback — in three steps.
method.step1Text: Workshops, questions, prioritization: before writing code, I align expected value with stakeholders.
method.step2Text: Progressive rollouts, reviews, and lightweight documentation: the team and users stay aligned.
method.step3Text: Metrics, field feedback, adjustments: continuous improvement is part of the job.

hero.tagline: Apprenticeship and industrial internship — Elonet & Renault. Agile missions, business modules, and real-time production.

stripe.title: Two contexts
stripe.text: At Elonet: short cycles, B2B clients, products around Dolibarr and custom interfaces. At Renault: factory constraints, production data, Symfony, and reliability requirements.

head.title: Choose a mission
head.lede: Switch between a long apprenticeship (Elonet) and an industrial internship (Renault).

elonet.title: Full stack developer — apprentice
elonet.evolutionText: I first joined for an end-of-study BTS SIO internship, then was hired as a full stack developer on a fixed-term contract during the following holidays. Eager to continue, I then joined an apprenticeship program to pursue my studies.
elonet.internalText: Business tools in an agile team; Vue.js & React interfaces; Python & PHP backends; CRM modules for Dolibarr — the same product focus from backlog to deployment.
elonet.clientText: Custom solutions from scoping to deployment; pair work or autonomy, with clear visibility on deadlines and delivery quality.
elonet.project1Desc: PHP modules for Dolibarr for external platform clients — business needs, integrations, and maintainable deliveries.
elonet.project2Desc: Autonomous mission: direct client exchanges, scoping, and delivery — first context where I led the client relationship end to end.
elonet.noteText: Two other deliveries can no longer be shown online: client liquidation and hosting termination — former URLs unavailable.
elonet.stackLine: Python (Django, Flask), PHP (Laravel, Symfony), React, Vue.js, SQL

renault.eyebrow: Internship · IT / assembly service · Real time
renault.title: Full stack developer — intern
renault.mediaAlt: Aerial view of Renault ElectriCity in Maubeuge
renault.missionText: Built a unit efficiency display with real-time visualization of production indicators (OEE / TRS) on the lines.
renault.backText: Business logic with Symfony 5, connections to internal factory software, and reliable data for operations steering.
renault.highlight1: Operator dashboards updated without disrupting line cadence.
renault.highlight2: Raw data progressively turned into indicators usable by workshop management.
